text:
maria: hey team, short notice — my flight just got delayed and I can't be on-call for the 20:00-04:00 window. i'm currently primary but we've already got two pages active (latency spike on embeds and an ingestion backlog). can someone take primary for the night? :airplane: :rotating_light:

alex: @maria ack — ouch. i can jump in as primary for the rest of the shift if no objections. i'm remote and can handle pager. pls hand off any active runbook pointers. :thumbsup:

sam: i can do secondary and shadow for the first hour to catch up on context. what are the active incidents?

maria: brief: 1) embeds service (embed-gen) latency spike, started ~19:30 — traces show CPU throttling on a subset of pods after a config rollout. 2) ingestion queue (uploader) backlog from S3 retry storms, started ~19:10; customers seeing delayed document processing. i've left links and a quick checklist.

redwood-incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT (IMPACT MEDIUM) - embed-gen latency spike - Incident ID: INC-2026-457. Pager triggered at 2026-03-15T19:31Z. Runbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/runbooks/embed-gen-latency

pagerduty-bot: :bell: PagerDuty alert for uploader-backlog (PD#U-88) — acknowledged by maria — assigned to primary: maria.

alex: copying checklist from maria. folks, if i'm taking primary: i will 1) claim in PagerDuty, 2) update rotation sheet, 3) confirm handoff in this thread, 4) take ownership of both incident threads and coordinate mitigations.

maria: exactly. two quick pointers i followed: - embed-gen: rollback last config (k8s deployment revision), restart affected pods in batch of 3. watch p95/p99 in APDEX dashboard. - uploader: pause retry worker, drain current queue, then ramp back at 10%/5min. blocked customers list at https://docs.redwood.ai/ops/blocked-customers.csv

alex: ok i claimed primary in PD and updated the rotation sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1X-redwood-rotation/edit#gid=0 — changed tonight to alex (please verify).

sam: verified the sheet change and pinged eng-sre channel to let infra know i'm shadowing for the first hour. jen, want to grab post-midnight secondary if alex is unavailable?

jen: i can do post-midnight secondary up to 04:00. i'll also pickup customer comms for any escalations.

maria: thanks team. quick runbook snippet i'm dropping here for embed rollback (copy/paste):

```bash
# rollback deployment to previous revision
kubectl -n prod rollout undo deployment/embed-gen-deployment
# restart 3 pods at a time
kubectl -n prod rollout status deployment/embed-gen-deployment
for i in $(kubectl -n prod get pods -l app=embed-gen -o name | head -n3); do kubectl -n prod delete $i; sleep 12; done
```

alex: running rollback now. i'll wait for PD to clear and will post status.

(redwood-incident-bot reaction: :eyes:)

sam: while alex is rolling back, i'm going to pause uploader retries (command and flag in runbook) and start a drain job on the backlog queue. copying command: `uploaderctl pause-retries --env prod`

alex: rollback completed, pods restarting, p95 dropped from 1.2s to 220ms on a canary set. pushing canary to 30% then full. posting metrics: https://dash.redwood.ai/embed-gen/compare?from=19:30&to=20:05

jen: noted — i'll draft a short customer-facing update if the p99 stabilizes. any sensitive customers hit the backlog?

sam: flagged 3 enterprise customers (IDs in the blocked-customers CSV). jen i can share a short blurb.

alex: rolling to full. monitoring KV cache and CPU. if latency creeps after full rollout, plan B is to pin to older quantized model variant (v2-q4) and route 100% traffic there.

maria: alex — thanks for stepping up. formal handoff checklist (can be copy-paste to PD):
- claimed incident in PagerDuty
- updated rotation sheet
- confirmed secondary (sam) and post-midnight backup (jen)
- linked runbooks and commands in PD notes
- verified initial mitigation (rollback) effect

alex: pasted checklist into PD notes and added this thread link. i am primary now.

pagerduty-bot: PD: Assignment change recorded — primary: alex, secondary: sam.

jen: small ask — can alex add a short 'known-good' tag to the embed-gen deployment if rollback stays stable for 20m? saves hunting later.

alex: will add tag and annotate the deployment with `ops:handed-off` once stable.

redwood-incident-bot: update: uploader backlog reduced by 78% after retries paused and drain job. ongoing watch.

maria: thanks again all. leaving final note — if anything spins up i trust you; i'm on airplane wifi so i'll stay on email but no pager. :wave:

alex: all good. will escalate to eng-sre if queue > 50k or p99 > 1s after full rollout. closing handoff here. :lock:

sam: copying key runbook links to the oncall-triage doc for future swaps.

jen: thanks. I'll be on for post-midnight and will take over secondary-to-primary if needed. good luck and ttyl. :coffee:
